answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, like a pigment that marks every item it touches: the bond is verified on-chain, an opal-like unique receipt ties one stake to one identity, and misbehavior burns part of the stake. Creating a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand bonds at the jetty where work enters the market, so a Sybil flood costs real capital upfront instead of just cheap account creation.
